summary: Follow-up static RE corrects the earlier model: xdbboxr.adf has 121 fields and 37 records, not 121 records and 37 fields. The fixed header is 24 bytes; a 31-byte packed 2-bit-per-field type map begins at +0x18; the row matrix begins at +0x38 with a 0xF2-byte stride. UpdateSelectBoxerInfo plus the generic XDB accessors map the core rating fields to exact inline signed-int16 tokens. Many non-rating field identities remain unresolved.

container.refpack_decode: clean: exact declared-size match, zero RefPack trailing bytes

field_count.evidence: func_001ACCAC bounds field_id against header[0]; func_001AD268 scans exactly header[0] 2-bit field-type codes.

record_count.evidence: func_001AD21C returns header[1]; func_001AD180 bounds record_index against header[1] and computes row = matrix_base + record_index*(field_count*2).

header.note: Bytes at +0x18 and +0x1C are not header words: +0x18 starts the packed field-type bitmap and +0x38 begins the aligned row matrix in xdbboxr.

field_type_table.layout: 2 bits per field, four fields per byte; field shift = 6 - ((field_id & 3)*2)

native_types.0: inline signed int16 stored directly in the row token
native_types.1: byte/string pool at payload + string_pool_base + signed16 token
native_types.2: int32 pool at payload + int32_pool_base + signed16(token)*4
native_types.3: float32 pool at payload + float_pool_base + signed16(token)*4

record_descriptor_matrix.evidence: func_001AD180 computes the matrix base as word2 - align4(field_count*record_count*2), then advances by field_count*2 per record. For xdbboxr the result is 0x38 and the padded matrix ends exactly at word2=0x2334.

select_boxer_ratings.field_storage: Fields 0x10-0x18 resolve as type 0 inline signed int16 tokens through func_001ACD40. Power averages two component fields; iOverall is computed separately.

fields.behavior: average of the two signed-int16 power components
computed by func_001D50F4; no direct raw XDB field asserted

roster_count_correction.finding: 121 is the XDB field/column count, not the boxer-record count. xdbboxr.adf contains 37 base rows/records in the tracked retail resource.
roster_count_correction.select_boxer_context: The normal stock SelectBoxer range table exposes IDs 0-34 across six divisions. Base rows 35 and 36 are now identified as bonus/hidden boxer records: Fabolous (global ID 74) and Little Mac (global ID 75).
roster_count_correction.global_indexing: func_00186284 resolves a numeric boxer ID through the registered table-instance chain and subtracts each table's dynamic record_count until the owning table is found.
roster_count_correction.hard_maximum: No hard total roster maximum is established. The base XDB record count is dynamic, boxer IDs are explicit data (field 0) rather than row indices, and the global resolver can span multiple table instances.

unresolved: Exact policy meaning of field 0x04: it is a proven boolean-like stock-vs-bonus discriminator, but whether its engine semantic is visible/selectable/unlocked/eligible remains to be named from a higher-level consumer.
Semantic identities and storage types for non-rating field IDs outside the recovered rating block.
Any independent save/UI limit on total boxer IDs across all registered table instances.
Exact original iOverall formula internals beyond the recovered helper boundary.

identity_fields.confidence: CONFIRMED for fields 0-2; PROBABLE for field 3's CRO/resource-stem role

fields.evidence: Rows 0-34 contain IDs 0-34 exactly; rows 35-36 contain 74 and 75 rather than their physical row indices. The global boxer resolver consumes numeric boxer IDs through the table-instance chain.
Decoded values include ALI, FRAZIER, HOLYFIELD, JONES JR, etc. func_001851CC reads field 2 then field 1 while composing the boxer display name.
Decoded values include MUHAMMAD, JOE, EVANDER, ROY, etc. func_001851CC reads field 2 before field 1 while composing the boxer display name.
Values are compact stems matching boxer identities, e.g. mali, jfra, ehol, rjon, mpac, fabo and spun.

base_records_outside_stock_ranges.confidence: CONFIRMED for identities/IDs; selection/unlock policy remains separate
base_records_outside_stock_ranges.finding: The two base-table rows outside the normal SelectBoxer ID ranges 0-34 are real bonus/hidden boxer records, not empty/template/custom-created slots.
base_records_outside_stock_ranges.custom_boxer_separation: GetSelectBoxerInfo has a separate created/custom-boxer path that emits iCustomBoxerID, strCustomBoxerName and iCustomBoxerWeightClass from session/custom state, independently of base rows 35-36.

selection_flag_candidate.observed_values: 1 for every normal stock SelectBoxer record 0-34; 0 for bonus rows 35-36.
selection_flag_candidate.executable_evidence: func_00185D84 reads field 4 and returns whether it is >0. A caller at 0x00278B0C iterates 35 stock boxer IDs, resolves each boxer, calls func_00185D84, and records a boolean result in a parallel table.
selection_flag_candidate.interpretation: standard-roster/selectability/eligibility flag. Exact distinction between visible, selectable and unlocked remains open.
